attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Energy Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Metallic Fury
steps: Before choosing a target, this character may choose whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Kinetic Field Generator
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: All Will Be Metal
superPowers.body: When defending against |!mystic| attacks, count each |!wild| result in the defense roll as 2 successes.

superPowers.name: Analyze and Annihilate
superPowers.body: While attacking, this character may reroll 1 of its attack dice for each |!critical| in the opposing defense roll.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side, and from 5 to 7 on Injured side.
Energy Blast now inflicts Incinerate on a |!wild|.
Kinetic Field Generator's throw now limited to terrain of Size 4 or less, instead of Size 3 or less.
Analyze and Annihilate was reworked and now allows to reroll attack dice for |!critical| results in the opposing roll, instead of adding additional dice for |!critical| results in the opposing roll.
